subject: MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing for NovaCore evaluation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@novacore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01 09:05 AM -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing for NovaCore evaluation

Emma —

Thanks again for the time this week. Quick MAP/checkpoint note after our call — trying to lock the pricing assumptions so we can hit the evaluation close target (internal map milestone: PO issued by Oct 8). Highlights below and a short list of action items.

Summary of ask from NovaCore:
- 12-month paid evaluation with a committed throughput profile (avg tokens/day) moving to a production pilot if performance meets criteria.
- Targeted budget for evaluation: ~$120k total over 12 months (customer-supplied guidance).
- Discount request: 15% off list for the pilot; request for a one-time $30k onboarding credit to offset integration work.

Current Redwood proposal (draft):
- 12-month commit: $12,000/month list (total $144,000)
- Proposed discount: 12% (with option to expand to 15% on signed commit of $150k ARR equivalent)
- Onboarding credit: $25k one-time credit applied to month 1 invoice

Action items from our call (owners):
- Emma / NovaCore: confirm internal approver for purchase order and whether procurement needs a revised SOW (owner: Emma) — due COB 2026-10-04
- Ben: follow up with Finance for exception approval for 15% discount + $30k credit (owner: Ben) — target 10/01
- Karthik: map approval path and required signatures for discounts >12% (owner: Karthik) — 10/02
- Laura: provide final credit approval conditions (owner: Laura) — 10/01

Attachments: attached latest MAP workbook (NovaCore_MAP_v3.xlsx) and pricing summary.

Proposed next touch: 30-min sync Friday 10/02 to finalize commit sizing and signoff path. Let me know a time that works.

Thanks,
Ben

Date: 2026-10-01 11:30 AM -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing for NovaCore evaluation

Ben / Laura —

Quick internal: finance & pricing review for the discount/credit asks. High level thoughts:
- 12% discount looks approvable under standard discount matrix for this segment; 15% requires either VP Sales approval or a show of a minimum 20% YOY retention guarantee (we can put that in contract).
- $25k onboarding credit is the typical threshold; $30k will need a split approval (onboarding credit + marketing or deal-specific credit).

If NovaCore can confirm $150k total commit (or a 12-month $12.5k/month minimum), I will route for VP sign-off. For 15% + $30k we need Sean's sign-off (CCed) and a brief justification note to attach to the approval request.

Please confirm the committed ARR equivalent and whether there are any nonstandard contract clauses the customer will want (e.g., extended data retention or private deployment).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Pricing & Commercial Ops
karthik@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01 01:05 PM -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing for NovaCore evaluation

Karthik / Ben —

Finance can support a compromise path: approve up to 12% discount + $25k onboarding credit now. For escalation to 15% and $30k credit we need:
- Signed intent to commit at $150k total (email or PO) OR
- A Deal Protection clause (12-month contract with minimum usage floors) in the SOW.

If we get either, I will clear the extra 3% and additional $5k credit. Otherwise we should proceed with 12% + $25k credit to keep momentum.

I'll prepare the credit terms doc and upload to the HUBSPOT deal record.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
laura@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per internal alignment above, here's the working offer we can push to procurement for review:

Working offer (to be included in quote/SOW):
- 12-month evaluation commit: $12,500/month list (total $150,000)
- Discount: 12% applied to list pricing (auto-bump to 15% if PO for $150k received before 2026-10-08 and Deal Protection clause included in SOW)
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 one-time credit applied month 1 (additional $5,000 available on approval conditions above)
- Condition: SOW to include standard Redwood Deal Protection (minimum usage floors) and standard data handling terms.

Next steps:
1) Emma/procurement: confirm PO timing and whether you need a redlined SOW (owner: NovaCore) — target: COB 2026-10-04
